name: Big and Big
kurzbeschreibung:
**Big and Big in Schwaz**

Discover the **Big and Big** experience in **Schwaz** – where tradition meets adventure in the heart of **Tirol**!

**Big** stands for **Bergbahnen Schwaz** – the modern cable car system that takes you effortlessly to the top of the **Hochzeiger** (1,834 m) and **Hochgriss** (1,930 m). Enjoy breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** and the **Kaisergebirge** from the comfort of our panoramic cable cars.

**Big** also means **Bergwelt Arena Schwaz** – the largest winter sports arena in **Tirol**! Whether you're a beginner or a pro, you’ll find the perfect slope here. After an exhilarating day on the slopes, warm up with a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** or a creamy **Kaiserschmarrn** at one of our cozy mountain huts.

But **Big** is more than just skiing and cable cars. Explore the historic **Schwazer Silberbergwerk** (Silver Mine), where you can delve into the region’s mining past. Or stroll through the charming old town of **Schwaz**, with its picturesque **Rathausplatz** and traditional **Tiroler architecture**.

And don’t miss the **Big** events! From the legendary **Schwazer Bergmarathon** to the lively **Schwazer Fasching**, there’s always something exciting happening.

**Schwaz** – where **Big** adventures await in every season!
